intro: Four modules follow the SC-900 skills measured: security concepts, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft security solutions and Microsoft compliance solutions.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: Study guide for Exam SC-900

modules.title: Concepts of security, compliance, and identity
modules.summary: Zero Trust, shared responsibility, defense in depth, encryption, and identity basics.

guide.html: About 10–15% of SC-900: the ideas the rest of the exam builds on.

Zero Trust follows three principles: verify explicitly, use least privilege access, and assume breach. Defense in depth uses layers (physical, identity, perimeter, network, compute, application, data). The CIA triad is confidentiality, integrity and availability. Under shared responsibility the customer always owns data, accounts and devices.

Encryption at rest protects stored data; encryption in transit protects data moving across a network. Symmetric encryption uses one key; asymmetric uses a public/private pair. Hashing produces a fixed fingerprint and cannot be reversed; it is used to store passwords and check integrity.

Authentication proves who you are; authorization decides what you can do. An identity provider creates and manages identities. Federation lets one identity provider be trusted by another, enabling single sign-on. Common protocols include SAML, OAuth and OpenID Connect.

tips: Authentication is who you are; authorization is what you may do.
Assume breach is a Zero Trust principle.
terms: Never trust, always verify, assume breach.
Layered protection so one failure is not fatal.
Deciding what an authenticated user can access.

slides.title: Zero Trust
script: Zero Trust removes implicit trust based on network location.

slides.title: Defense in depth
bullets: Failure of one layer is tolerable

modules.title: Capabilities of Microsoft Entra
modules.summary: Entra ID, authentication methods, Conditional Access, governance and identity protection.

guide.html: About 25–30%. Entra is Microsoft's identity and access product family.

Microsoft Entra ID is the cloud directory. Identity types include users, groups, workload identities, devices and external identities. Authentication methods include passwords, MFA, passwordless (Windows Hello, FIDO2 security keys, Microsoft Authenticator) and self-service password reset (SSPR). Hybrid identity syncs on-premises Active Directory using Entra Connect.

Conditional Access is the Zero Trust policy engine: if signals (user, device, location, risk) match, then grant, require MFA or block. Entra ID Protection detects risky sign-ins and users. Global Administrator is the highest-privilege role.

Privileged Identity Management (PIM) gives just-in-time, approved, time-limited elevated roles. Access reviews periodically confirm who still needs access. Entitlement management packages access for requests. Lifecycle workflows automate joiner, mover and leaver tasks.

tips: Conditional Access is if-then; PIM is just-in-time.
Passwordless options are FIDO2, Windows Hello and Authenticator.
terms: If-then policies that gate access using signals.
Requires two or more proofs of identity.
Detects and responds to identity risk.

slides.title: Conditional Access
script: Policies combine signals and enforce a decision.

slides.title: Governance
script: Governance keeps access appropriate over time.

modules.title: Capabilities of Microsoft security solutions
modules.summary: Network and platform protection, Defender, Sentinel and the Defender portal.

guide.html: Azure DDoS Protection defends against volumetric attacks. Azure Firewall is a managed network firewall. Web Application Firewall (WAF) protects web apps from attacks like SQL injection. Network security groups filter traffic by rules; Azure Bastion gives browser-based RDP/SSH without public IPs. Key Vault stores secrets, keys and certificates.

Microsoft Defender for Cloud provides CSPM (posture, secure score, recommendations) and CWPP (workload protection) across Azure, other clouds and on-premises. The Defender XDR family covers: Defender for Endpoint (devices), Defender for Office 365 (email and collaboration), Defender for Identity (on-premises AD signals), Defender for Cloud Apps (a CASB) and Defender Vulnerability Management.

Microsoft Sentinel is a cloud SIEM and SOAR. It collects data with connectors, detects threats with analytics rules, groups alerts into incidents, automates responses with playbooks (Logic Apps), supports threat hunting with KQL queries, and visualizes data with workbooks.

tips: SIEM collects and detects; SOAR automates response.
WAF is for web attacks; Firewall is for network traffic.
terms: Protects web apps from common exploits.
Controls and monitors cloud app use.

slides.title: Defender family
script: XDR correlates signals across these products.

slides.title: Sentinel flow
script: Sentinel turns raw logs into incidents and automated responses.

modules.title: Capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions
modules.summary: Service Trust Portal, Purview, information protection, data loss prevention, eDiscovery and insider risk.

guide.html: About 20–25%. Microsoft Purview is the compliance and data governance portfolio.

The Service Trust Portal publishes audit reports and compliance documents. Compliance Manager scores your compliance posture and suggests improvement actions. Privacy principles and data residency concerns drive where data is stored.

Sensitivity labels classify and protect content, optionally encrypting it. Data loss prevention (DLP) policies block or warn when sensitive data is shared. Retention policies and labels keep or delete content for set periods. Records management locks records. Data Map and Unified Catalog help discover and govern data.

eDiscovery finds content for legal cases, with holds. Audit records user and admin activity. Communication Compliance detects policy-violating messages. Insider Risk Management flags risky user behavior such as data theft. Information barriers prevent groups from communicating.

tips: Labels classify; DLP prevents sharing; retention keeps or deletes.
terms: Prevents sensitive data from being shared inappropriately.
Defines how long content is kept.
Search and hold of content for legal needs.

slides.title: Protect and govern data
script: Purview controls apply across the data lifecycle.

slides.title: Investigations
script: Use the right tool for the question being asked.
